heritage.story: Railroad developer Henry B. Plant opened the Hotel Belleview in 1897; as the Belleview-Biltmore it was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1979. On December 21, 2016 a preserved section with the original lobby and 35 guest rooms was rotated and moved 375 feet east, and it opened as the restored Belleview Inn on December 5, 2018.

heritage.story: Construction of the Hotel Floridan began in 1926 and it opened in 1927 with 19 floors and 316 rooms; it was Tampa's tallest building until 1966. Its Sapphire Room bar was a World War II nightspot for servicemen training at nearby Drew Field. The hotel closed to overnight guests in 1966 and shut in 1989. After a long restoration it reopened as the Floridan Palace Hotel in 2012, and in January 2024 it reopened as Hotel Flor Tampa Downtown, Tapestry Collection by Hilton.

heritage.story: Legend holds that Hernando de Soto named the Espiritu Santo Springs in 1539, though historians question whether he visited. Colonel William J. Olympia Development Group bought the spa in 2004 and renovated it.

name: The Vinoy Resort & Golf Club, Autograph Collection
summary: A pink Mediterranean Revival resort hotel on the downtown St. Petersburg waterfront that opened on New Year's Eve 1925. It has a pool with cabanas, a spa, a marina, tennis courts, its own golf club and seven dining venues.
quote: Occupying an enviable spot along the water's edge of downtown St. Petersburg, since 1925, this legendary hotel has been a symbol of timeless elegance, combining nuanced nostalgia with modern sophistication.

heritage.story: Aymer Vinoy Laughner built the Vinoy Park Hotel; construction under architect Henry L. Taylor and contractor George A. Miller began on February 5, 1925, and the hotel opened on New Year's Eve 1925. On July 3, 1942 it stopped operating as a hotel and was leased to the U.S. Army Air Force as a training facility. It closed in 1974 and, after a community petition, was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1978. Restoration began in May 1990 and it reopened as a Stouffer hotel in 1992.
heritage.visiting: It operates as a full-service hotel; its restaurants, bars and spa are on site.

notes: Rooms 354 per the Visit St. Pete/Clearwater listing and its 'Best Downtown Hotels' article; Wikipedia cites 362 rooms at the 2018 sale. Pet amenities and 70,000 sq ft of event space per thevinoy.com.
